featured_reviews.name: tressC
featured_reviews.review_text: I think this store used to be called Ashish Binit when I was little. It's nice to see that they have upgraded and revamped the entire store in keeping up with times. This place has everything you need. I know of friends who are from Gorai area but prefer to shop here for their 'daily needs'. Service is class and you get stuff ranging from groceries to veggies to cold drinks, ice creams, baking goods, stationary etc. etc. The aisles are neatly stacked and there's always help around to guide you with your purchase.

featured_reviews.name: Balkrishna Varma (listenbk)
featured_reviews.review_text: This is the place where you can buy all your daily needs products. Well organized and and systematic. hygiene is on priority  the staff are so polite and humble. Seperate racks for everything. it's near my friends please so we visited. Really they can't live without this shop. Everybody from their society buy daily needs products from this store only.

featured_reviews.name: Soi Thangsing
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had been loyal customers to this place for 3+ years until a recent incident gave me a very BITTER experience.

The same delivery man who delivers 20L of water along with his colleagues back at the shop outright REFUSED and REJECTED the SAME WATER BOTTLE that they delivered to us, pinning BLAME on US saying that we have replaced the bluish tint bottles with some old looking bottles that they have apparently started rejecting.

It was as if you are framing us for the SAME GOODS that YOU DELIVER.

BE CAREFUL if you are buying from here as they will FLIP on the customer.

Not only that, the DELIVERY GUY was EXTRA RUDE barking like I owe him money since 10 years putting FALSE BLAME on US.

It's too bad, just be careful because "Pride goes before destruction, And an haughty spirit before a fall".

I am SERIOUSLY RECONSIDERING my patronage to this shop and I ADVISE CAUTION before you go on trusting them.

featured_reviews.name: Robin Ds
featured_reviews.review_text: Kindly avoid this place. Reason being products are not always fresh and close to expiry. Also the support staff and cashier are least bothered about customer experience they are only interested in billing. On two occasions they made a mistake with billing (charged the full amount for 1+Free), wrong price tag on the product, and billing the same product twice. Instead of accepting their mistake they tried to give lame reasons. Somehow I don't trust import stuff they are selling if it's genuine or not

featured_reviews.name: nilanjana biswas
featured_reviews.review_text: Daily Needs is a very exciting store for all one's grocery requirements. There's a wide range of products available including goods from abroad, especially chocolates and cheese. The quality of the products is also very good. Of course it also stocks the regular items one needs on a daily basis. A must visit for all. It's stock of muesli is good. It also stocks ITC frozen products and a variety of ice creams too. Have a look for yourself.

featured_reviews.name: ᴇʙɪɴ
featured_reviews.review_text: DiMart is one of the best go-to spot for budget shopping, especially if you're looking for inexpensive clothing. Their selection of groceries and household items is also affordable, though not as cheap as their clothing range. However, be prepared for chaos during holidays—it gets incredibly crowded. The customer service leaves much to be desired; staff often seem clueless about where to find items, which can make shopping frustrating. If you're after deals and can overlook the service and crowds, it's worth a visit for the savings.

featured_reviews.name: tressC
featured_reviews.review_text: Good place to shop for all your grocery and toiletries needs because of the great discounts. D Mart caters to all household requirements from A to Z! The staff were helpful & courteous and very hard working, constantly on their feet keeping things by and right. This place gets overcrowded though with entire families coming for all their shopping needs. The best time to enjoy a relaxed shopping experience is 9 to 11 in the mornings and 2 to 5 in the afternoons. It is a store of ground plus two floors so do visit with your walking shoes on 😄

featured_reviews.name: Monika Sharma up
featured_reviews.review_text: I like your service and it’s too good to come there. It’s clean and you have very good service people in their checks you before coming in, and when you go out of the shop, you get ₹20 ice cream in three flavours.

featured_reviews.name: rakesh pareek
featured_reviews.review_text: Very good place for budget shopping of your daily household needs,offer is going on 12 months a year. To save your time you can also order online now from there app "Dmart" to your near by pickup shops that you find in this app.

featured_reviews.name: Nirav Vaghela
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is awesome! 🤩 I always find exactly what I need, and the prices are fantastic. 💰 The staff is super friendly and helpful too. 😊 Such a great shopping experience! 🛒🛍️🌟👍

featured_reviews.name: Nandkishor Thorat
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dmart is the place where most of things which are required for daily needs of life are available at reasonable price.

To visit here, try on weekdays or on odd times, or else this is one of the busiest place for shopping. If possible avoid this place on Sunday/holidays/festive time during peak time. As you won’t be able to shop properly.

Second thing to consider with regards to cloths, even if they are cheaper most of the times they won’t last long. So just check the quality or buy the clothes which are bit on Higher sides.

Rest of the products are of good quality.

This Dmart is in between borivali and Dahisar. And is on the Link Road.

Also note: pics uploaded by here are not own by me.
